method: Preserved TVDog and operator-supplied bytes. Selected members were decompressed and hashed. Advertised compatibility comes from package documentation or catalogue descriptions.

status_definitions.environment-ready: Named environment exercised for a related operation.
status_definitions.launched: Execution observed; operation output still unverified.
status_definitions.qualified: Named operation observed and independently checked in this campaign.
status_definitions.qualified-prior: Named operation retained from prior native reports.
status_definitions.blocked: An attempted step could not meet a named prerequisite.

operations.name: DBrepair
operations.advertised_compatibility: DeskMate and Home Organizer database types per README
operations.smoke_test: Repair healthy QRECORD then one dangling DATA locator; cold reopen both.
operations.evidence: Both converge to the same normalized FIL; DBCOLS IDs changed.
operations.follow_up: Expand to multiple DATA pages before additional application profiles.

operations.name: DBrepair through Fil2dbf runtime
operations.advertised_compatibility: documented Fil2dbf recovery handoff
operations.smoke_test: Exercise the documented repair handoff on one recoverable input.
operations.evidence: Shared PDM verified; DOS export works; repair handoff unobserved.
operations.follow_up: Find an input-processing error that offers the handoff.

operations.name: Fil2dbf PDM
operations.advertised_compatibility: Filer and Address Book discussed; Calendar and recipe limitations
operations.publication: author permits free distribution; program held privately
operations.smoke_test: Export QRECORD DATA as FTXT_A, then try a non-database ASCII marker.
operations.evidence: Matched expected DBF; invalid input left a zero-byte DBF.
operations.follow_up: Try sorted multi-field numeric and decimal controls.

operations.name: Fil2dbf DOS
operations.dependencies: isolated DOS; runtime on PATH; own DMCONFIG
operations.advertised_compatibility: DOS form prompts without command-line filenames
operations.publication: author permits free distribution; bundled runtime private
operations.smoke_test: Launch, cancel mouse setup and export DOSGOOD.FIL DATA as FTXT_A.
operations.evidence: Byte-identical DBF to native; launcher uses the same conversion PDM.
operations.follow_up: Compare additional field categories in both runtime modes.
